description:
System Marker

Requires LazyLib
Can be added and removed safely
Change Log

This mod adds several grafical information markers.

Ship System Marker - shows the remaining of your ship's system, and cooling down with a ring.
Special System Marker - Shows the remaining of your ship's special defence system, and cool down with a ring.
Shield marker - Shows the shield states including max arc, current facing.
Ammo Remaining Marker - Shows weapons' ammo remaining of the ally ship which you locked on.
Weapon repair Marker - Shows offlined weapons' repair progress of your ship and the ship which you locked on.
Engine Repair Marker - Shows offlined engines' repair progress of your ship and the ship which you locked on.
Torpedo Marker - Shows unguided torpedos which may hit your ship in several seconds.
Mine Marker - Shows mines arounds your ship which may cause damage.
Torpedo Alarm - Plays three levels of alarms based on the total damage of torpedos and mines.

Almost all of the parameter can be modified in SYSTEM_MARKER_OPTIONS.ini, or using LunaLib in game.
This mod DOES NOT CONTAIN, and DOES NOT DEPENDENT ON Flux Reticle.
This mod WORKS WELL ALONE, and also works well with Flux Reticle.

Provides an alarm system for torpedo and mine damage and allows parameter customization via configuration files or in-game settings.
